verdict.rationale: Visualizing a commit graph is a fair question for a mobile GitHub client, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a branch or commit-graph view: the docs cover pull request review, issues, Copilot agent tasks and code search. A community member also describes the app as 'more the social fluff' than a git client.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can visualize the full commit graph across branches
